title: Finnish Pin Toss
description: The Finnish lawn game of numbered skittles with real tumbling physics. Pull back, let go, and land on exactly 50 against four rivals or friends on one phone.
howToPlay: Press on the lawn and pull straight down, then let go to throw.
Hold still to shrink the ring and steady your hand.
One skittle scores its number; several score how many fell.
Land on exactly 50 to win; go over and drop back to 25.
Three misses in a row and you are out.
